title: Customizations
description: V17 — Calmer session panel (from the Nov 18 Agents Window + Customization Squad syncs). Polishes only the right-side Session Customizations panel, the piece going into code behind an experimental setting. Less visual noise: no count bubbles, no logo card, no external-link icons; switches appear on hover/focus and Off items just say "Off". A "Needs Attention" group gathers sign-in and errors with one text action each. Plugin-provided MCP servers (Semgrep) show their plugin, and when the plugin is off they say why they're unavailable. Just-in-time access: in the "Triage customization migration issues" session the agent asks to use Slack, which is off for this session, and offers Allow Once / Turn On for This Session inline in chat. The modal is unchanged from V16.
